thread:
Marisol: Hey team — quick scrub on customer 'RavenCo' private deploy. Observability gaps flagged in week1 run: VPC flow logs not appearing in Splunk, KMS key-usage events missing from CloudTrail, and missing token mapping in our sidecar. Need short-term mitigations and long-term owners.

Tomas: saw the flow logs config — they set log-destination to a Kinesis stream in acct 987654321 but our ingestion IAM role is in acct 111222333. probably a cross-account IAM trust missing.

Samira: yep. CloudTrail shows PutObject to s3://raven-logs but no kms:Decrypt entries — KMS key policy likely lacks our CloudTrail role. I can propose a minimal policy.

Ben: also the sidecar (our telemetry-forwarder) crashed on startup with OOM in the bundle logs. attach snippet:

Ben:
```
2026-03-17T15:04:12Z forwarder ERROR oom killed process pid=2214
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/forwarder/main.py", line 82, in start
    stream = open_stream(config)
MemoryError
```

Marisol: ugh. Customer ramp today at 3pm PT. Can we do a temporary handoff: Samira to push a key policy patch, Tomas to add cross-account trust, Ben to restart sidecar with 512MB limit -> set to 1GB? I'll create a ticket.

Samira: draft policy:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowCloudTrail",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/RedwoodCloudTrailRole"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```
I'll paste in PR to customer's repo once Tomas confirms account IDs.

Tomas: confirmed — Kinesis stream in 987654321 should be fine if we attach trust. I'll open a quick ticket with network infra to add sts:AssumeRole trust to: arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/RedwoodIngestRole

Marisol: ticket created: CS-4287. linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/privnet-observability-checklist . Can we have owners update within 2 hours? customer go/no-go decision at 17:00 UTC.

Ben: restarted forwarder with env override MEM_LIMIT=1024 and turned on verbose logs. For now it's forwarding to S3 directly to avoid Kinesis mapping until trust is set. Logs show PUTs succeeding.

DeployBot: Deployment 2026-03-17T16:01:02Z: forwarder v1.3.7 deployed to ravenco-prod-sidecar (ok)

Samira: I pushed the policy patch to their infra repo as pr #67. also posted the minimal audit log checklist in the runbook.

Tomas: network asked for the exact flow log ARN to whitelist. it's arn:aws:logs:us-west-2:987654321:log-group:/aws/vpc/flow-logs:ravenco

Marisol: perfect. I'll update the customer slack and propose two options: (A) short-term: our sidecar -> S3 direct + key policy patch + cross-account trust; (B) long-term: unify to Kinesis with proper cross-account role + increase sidecar memory + set up CloudWatch agent. Which do we prefer?

Ben: A for immediate, B for next sprint. Also raising renewal-risk note: if we don't hit telemetry by week2, ops SLA might be flagged. Documenting in CS-4287.

Samira: agree. I'll add acceptance criteria in the PR: CloudTrail shows kms:Decrypt events, FlowLog PutLogEvents visible in Splunk, and no forwarder OOMs for 24h.

Marisol: thanks. Owners: Tomas (network trust & flow logs), Samira (KMS policy & audit), Ben (sidecar memory + temporary s3 path). I'll check back at 16:45 UTC. :thumbsup:

Tomas: on it.

Ben: on it.

Samira: will follow up when PR merged.

Marisol: updating customer now — short note posted in #ravenco-support. will ping here if they escalate.
